figures.Fig17.5: The reaction of CaCO3 is used to produce lime (CaO). Original figure archived as c12-chem-ch17-fig-lime-kiln (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The printed kiln picture labels 600 C and 300 C inside the kiln, below the 900-1000 C given in the text; the original diagram follows the text. The book says removing CO2 makes the reaction 'occur faster'; removing a product shifts the equilibrium (yield), as the next sentence says.
